pr_body:
Currently, when logging the connection or reconnection of a peer, the log is line fully redacted. This impedes diagnosing network issues.

Fix the redaction by printing a `SafeString` into the buffer, rather than a raw `string`, which is marked as unsafe by default.

Fix #133218.

Release note: None.

This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/133219)

Before:

```
$ rm -rf /tmp/cockroach/ && ./cockroach start-single-node --store /tmp/cockroach --insecure --log="file-defaults: {redact: true}"
...
I241023 04:27:55.211378 2079 2@rpc/peer.go:589 ⋮ [T1,Vsystem,n1,rnode=1,raddr=‹×›,class=system,rpc] 3  ‹×›
I241023 04:27:55.211328 2163 2@rpc/peer.go:589 ⋮ [T1,Vsystem,n1,rnode=1,raddr=‹×›,class=default,rpc] 4  ‹×›
```

After:

```
$ rm -rf /tmp/cockroach/ && ./cockroach start-single-node --store /tmp/cockroach --insecure --log="file-defaults: {redact: true}"
...
I241023 04:15:40.351801 2151 2@rpc/peer.go:589 ⋮ [T1,Vsystem,n1,rnode=1,raddr=‹×›,class=default,rpc] 3  connection is now healthy
I241023 04:15:40.351898 2159 2@rpc/peer.go:589 ⋮ [T1,Vsystem,n1,rnode=1,raddr=‹×›,class=system,rpc] 4  connection is now healthy
```

LGTM - that this works like this is surprising to me. For comparison, in

```go
randomString := "hey"
log.Infof(ctx, "I don't get redacted but %s does", randomString)
```

the format string will not be redacted. (You'll get "I don't get redacted but <hey> does"). We make this safe by enforcing that only constant strings can be passed to `Infof`.

@dhartunian any idea why we're not doing a similar thing for `redact.Fprintf` (and in fact the entire `f` family of redact helpers)?

issue_context.title: rpc: redaction obscures useful information about peer disconnects
issue_context.body:
Currently, when a peer disconnects or connects, the log line is fully redacted.

For example:

```
Oct 21 21:21:10.370
crl-prod-kb2-eu-west-1-ip-10-248-1-9.eu-west-1.compute.internal
crl-prod-kb2-eu-west-1-ip-10-248-1-9.eu-west-1.compute.internal
cockroachdb
‹×›

Oct 21 21:21:10.370
crl-prod-kb2-eu-west-1-ip-10-248-1-9.eu-west-1.compute.internal
crl-prod-kb2-eu-west-1-ip-10-248-1-9.eu-west-1.compute.internal
cockroachdb
disconnected (was healthy for 1.025s): grpc: ‹×› [code 2/Unknown]
```

Fix the redaction.

Jira issue: CRDB-43507


Epic CRDB-37617
